response.rationale: Both answers fit the cue and sense. Indonesian mengutip is the ordinary verb for quoting, while Malaysian memetik is a characteristic choice for quoting; mengutip also exists in Malaysian Malay. The relation is valid as a preference contrast, not an exclusive distinction. No false-friend contrast is present.
